method: Every HydroLAKES v1.0 polygon in the US, Canada and Mexico was matched to the coverage of the 7,117 active NOAA ENC cells; the 3,302 cells meeting a lake were read with GDAL S-57 (updates applied). Per lake: chartedShare is the share of the lake inside DEPARE areas deeper than 0 m; contourLevels counts distinct DEPCNT values above 0 m; soundings counts SOUNDG points inside the lake (most in any one cell); verticalDatums are the cells' sounding datums (DSPM_SDAT). Tier A: chartedShare >= 0.5, 2+ contour levels and 10+ soundings. B: chartedShare >= 0.2 with a contour level or 10+ soundings. C: depth bands only. Names from USGS NHD, places from Census TIGERweb.
